title: Geography: Mineral and Energy resources (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en: Peat coal has _____ carbon and ______ moisture content.
questions.q_hi: पीट कोयले में _____ कार्बन व ______ नमी सामग्री होती है।
questions.solution_en: Decaying plants in swamps produce peat, which has low carbon and high moisture contents and low heating capacity.
questions.solution_hi: दलदलों में सड़ रहे पौधे पीट कोयला उत्पन्न करते हैं, जिसमें कार्बन कम व नमी अधिक होती है तथा ताप क्षमता कम होती है।

questions.q_en: What resource is found in sedimentary rocks on the western and eastern flanks of the peninsula in Gujarat and Assam?
questions.q_hi: गुजरात व असम में प्रायद्वीप के पश्चिमी व पूर्वी किनारों पर अवसादी चट्टानों में कौन सा संसाधन पाया जाता है?
questions.solution_en:
• Sedimentary rocks are produced by the weathering of pre-existing rocks and the subsequent transportation and deposition of the weathering products.

• Sedimentary rocks on the western and eastern flanks of the peninsula in Gujarat and Assam have most of the petroleum deposits.
questions.solution_hi:
• अवसादी चट्टानें पूर्व-मौजूदा चट्टानों के अपक्षय व अपक्षय उत्पादों के परिवहन व निक्षेपण से उत्पन्न होती हैं।

• गुजरात व असम में प्रायद्वीप के पश्चिमी व पूर्वी किनारों पर अवसादी चट्टानों में अधिकांश पेट्रोलियम निक्षेप पाए जाते हैं।

questions.q_en: Which of the following sites do "Not" have coal mines?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थल पर कोयला खान "नहीं" है?
questions.solution_en: Raniganj, Jharia, Bokaro, Talcher, Korba, Singrauli, Singareni, and Neyveli are prominent coal mining areas in India. While Sonipat do not have any coal mines.
questions.solution_hi: रानीगंज, झरिया, बोकारो, तालचर, कोरबा, सिंगरौली, सिंगरेनी व नेवेली भारत में प्रमुख कोयला खनन क्षेत्र हैं। जबकि सोनीपत में कोई कोयला खान नहीं है।

questions.q_en: In which of the following regions in India are there high-grade iron ore deposits?
questions.q_hi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र में उच्च-श्रेणी के लौह अयस्क निक्षेप हैं?
questions.solution_en: High-grade iron ore deposits are primarily located in Northern Odisha region of India, particularly in areas like Keonjhar and Sundargarh districts. These deposits are crucial for the iron and steel industry, contributing significantly to India's mineral wealth and industrial development.
questions.solution_hi: उच्च-श्रेणी के लौह अयस्क निक्षेप मुख्यतः भारत के उत्तरी ओडिशा क्षेत्र में स्थित हैं, विशेषकर क्योंझर व सुंदरगढ़ जिलों जैसे क्षेत्रों में। ये निक्षेप लोहा-इस्पात उद्योग हेतु महत्वपूर्ण हैं, जो भारत की खनिज संपदा व औद्योगिक विकास में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान देते हैं।

questions.q_en: The principal ______ reserves are in Neyveli in Tamil Nadu.
questions.q_hi: तमिलनाडु के नेवेली में मुख्य ______ भंडार हैं।
questions.solution_en: Neyveli in Tamil Nadu is known for its significant lignite reserves. Lignite, often referred to as brown coal, is a low-grade, soft form of coal used primarily for electricity generation due to its relatively high moisture content and lower energy density compared to other coal types.
questions.solution_hi: तमिलनाडु के नेवेली में मुख्य लिग्नाइट भंडार हैं। लिग्नाइट, जिसे अक्सर भूरा कोयला कहा जाता है, कोयले का एक निम्न-श्रेणी, मुलायम रूप है जो अन्य कोयला प्रकारों की तुलना में अपेक्षाकृत उच्च नमी सामग्री व कम ऊर्जा घनत्व के कारण मुख्यतः बिजली उत्पादन हेतु उपयोग होता है।

questions.q_en: Oil India Limited (OIL) is under the administrative structure of:
questions.q_hi: ऑइल इंडिया लिमिटेड (OIL) किसके प्रशासनिक ढाँचे के अंतर्गत है:
options_en: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
questions.solution_en:
· Oil India Limited (OIL) is a Maharatna public sector undertaking (PSU) engaged in exploration, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas.

· It operates under the administrative control of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India.

Key Functions of OIL:

(a) Hydrocarbon exploration in India (e.g., Assam, Rajasthan) and abroad.

(b) Operates pipelines like the Numaligarh-Siliguri Pipeline.

Why Not Other Ministries?

· Ministry of Power (2): Handles electricity generation/distribution (e.g., NTPC).

· Ministry of Commerce (3): Oversees trade policies (e.g., DGFT).

· Ministry of New Energy (4): Focuses on solar/wind energy (e.g., SECI).
questions.solution_hi:
• ऑइल इंडिया लिमिटेड (OIL) कच्चे तेल व प्राकृतिक गैस के अन्वेषण, उत्पादन व परिवहन में लगा एक महारत्न सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र उपक्रम (PSU) है।

• यह भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम व प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय के प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण में कार्य करता है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following sedimentary minerals, known to everyone as 'salt', usually forms in arid climates where sea water evaporates?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अवसादी खनिज, जिसे सभी 'नमक' के रूप में जानते हैं, आमतौर पर शुष्क जलवायु में बनता है जहाँ समुद्री जल वाष्पित होता है?
questions.solution_en: Halite, commonly known as 'salt,' is a sedimentary mineral that primarily forms in arid climates through the evaporation of seawater. This process results in the crystallization of halite, and it is a prevalent source of sodium chloride, widely used for culinary and industrial purposes.
questions.solution_hi: हैलाइट, जिसे आमतौर पर 'नमक' कहा जाता है, एक अवसादी खनिज है जो मुख्यतः शुष्क जलवायु में समुद्री जल के वाष्पीकरण से बनता है। इस प्रक्रिया के परिणामस्वरूप हैलाइट का क्रिस्टलीकरण होता है, और यह सोडियम क्लोराइड का एक प्रचलित स्रोत है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following is an inosilicate amphibole mineral used in highway construction and as railroad ballast?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा इनोसिलिकेट एम्फिबोल खनिज राजमार्ग निर्माण व रेलमार्ग गिट्टी के रूप में उपयोग होता है?
questions.solution_en:
Hornblende is an inosilicate mineral belonging to the amphibole group, commonly used in road construction and railroad ballast due to its hardness and durability.

• Shale: A sedimentary rock used in bricks and ceramics.

• Olivine: A greenish mineral found in igneous rocks, used in steel manufacturing.

• Geyserite: A form of silica deposited around hot springs and geysers.
questions.solution_hi:
हॉर्नब्लेंड एक इनोसिलिकेट खनिज है जो एम्फिबोल समूह से संबंधित है, जो अपनी कठोरता व स्थायित्व के कारण सामान्यतः सड़क निर्माण व रेलमार्ग गिट्टी में उपयोग होता है।

• शेल: ईंटों व सिरेमिक में उपयोग होने वाली एक अवसादी चट्टान।

• ओलिवाइन: आग्नेय चट्टानों में पाया जाने वाला हरा खनिज, इस्पात निर्माण में उपयोग होता है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following sites do "Not" have nuclear power plant?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थल पर परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र "नहीं" है?
questions.solution_en:
In India, nuclear power ranks as the fifth-largest contributor to the country's electricity production, following coal, gas, hydroelectricity, and wind power.

India has several nuclear power plant sites, including Narora, Tarapur, and Rawatbhata. But Vijayawada do not have a nuclear power plant.
questions.solution_hi:
भारत में, परमाणु ऊर्जा देश के बिजली उत्पादन में कोयला, गैस, जलविद्युत व पवन ऊर्जा के बाद पाँचवाँ सबसे बड़ा योगदानकर्ता है।

भारत में नरोरा, तारापुर व रावतभाटा सहित कई परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र स्थल हैं। परंतु विजयवाड़ा में कोई परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र नहीं है।

questions.q_en: Identify a conventional source of energy from the following options.
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से ऊर्जा के एक परंपरागत स्रोत की पहचान करें।
questions.solution_en:
Conventional sources of energy are those that have been traditionally used for a long time and are generally non-renewable or have been used in traditional, less processed forms for centuries. Among the options:

· Cattle dung: Cattle dung (cow dung cakes, etc.) has been used as a traditional fuel for cooking and heating in many parts of the world, including India, for centuries. It is a form of biomass energy used in a conventional, often unprocessed manner.

Explanation of Other Options:

These are generally considered non-conventional or newer sources of energy, or require advanced technology:

• Geothermal energy: Utilizes heat from the Earth's interior. Considered a non-conventional/renewable source.

• Atomic energy (Nuclear energy): Derived from nuclear reactions. While developed in the 20th century, it's often categorized separately from traditional fossil fuels and considered non-conventional in some contexts, or a distinct category of conventional non-renewable (due to uranium fuel). However, compared to cattle dung's ancient use, atomic energy is modern.

• Solar power: Utilizes energy from the sun. Considered a non-conventional/renewable source.

If "conventional" implies non-renewable fossil fuels (coal, oil, natural gas) primarily, then the question might be tricky. However, "conventional" can also mean "traditionally used." In that sense, cattle dung fits best. Atomic energy is a powerful source but not "conventional" in the sense of long-standing traditional use like biomass.

Further insights:

• Conventional energy sources often include fossil fuels (coal, petroleum, natural gas) and firewood/traditional biomass. Hydroelectric power is sometimes considered conventional as well due to its long history of use.

• Non-conventional (or Renewable/Alternative) energy sources include solar energy, wind energy, geothermal energy, tidal energy, and modern biomass (e.g., biofuels). Nuclear energy is sometimes grouped with conventional non-renewable or as a separate category.

• Given the options, cattle dung as a traditional biomass fuel is the most fitting "conventional" source in the sense of long historical usage.
questions.solution_hi:
ऊर्जा के परंपरागत स्रोत वे हैं जिनका पारंपरिक रूप से लंबे समय से उपयोग होता आया है और सामान्यतः या तो अनवीकरणीय हैं या सदियों से पारंपरिक, कम प्रसंस्कृत रूपों में उपयोग होते आए हैं। विकल्पों में से:

• गोबर: गोबर (उपले आदि) कई क्षेत्रों में खाना पकाने व गर्म करने हेतु पारंपरिक ईंधन के रूप में उपयोग होता आया है।

questions.q_en: The famous Hirakud Captive Thermal Power plant is located in which of the following states?
questions.q_hi: प्रसिद्ध हीराकुड कैप्टिव तापीय बिजली संयंत्र निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य में स्थित है?
questions.solution_en: The Hirakud Power Plant is a coal-based captive thermal power plant situated in the Sambalpur district of Odisha, near Hirakud.
questions.solution_hi: हीराकुड बिजली संयंत्र ओडिशा के संबलपुर जिले में, हीराकुड के पास स्थित एक कोयला-आधारित कैप्टिव तापीय बिजली संयंत्र है।

questions.q_en: The district of Shivamogga that is famous for its Iron-Ore and Manganese mineral is located in which state of India?
questions.q_hi: शिवमोग्गा जिला, जो अपने लौह अयस्क व मैंगनीज खनिज के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
questions.solution_en:
· Shivamogga (Shimoga) district is located in the state of Karnataka.

· It is rich in mineral resources, especially:

o Iron ore

o Manganese

· The region is part of the Western Ghats and also known for its lush forests, rivers, and Jog Falls.

Other States:

· Maharashtra - Known for coal, limestone, and bauxite.

· Rajasthan - Rich in zinc, lead, copper, and marble.

· Jharkhand - Famous for coal, iron ore, and uranium.
questions.solution_hi:
• शिवमोग्गा (शिमोगा) जिला कर्नाटक राज्य में स्थित है।

• यह विशेषकर निम्नलिखित खनिज संसाधनों से समृद्ध है:

o लौह अयस्क

o मैंगनीज

• यह क्षेत्र पश्चिमी घाट का भाग है और अपने हरे-भरे जंगलों, नदियों व जोग जलप्रपात के लिए भी जाना जाता है।

questions.q_en: The study of the structure, evolution and dynamics of Earth and its natural mineral and energy resources is called:
questions.q_hi: पृथ्वी की संरचना, विकास व गतिशीलता तथा इसके प्राकृतिक खनिज व ऊर्जा संसाधनों के अध्ययन को कहा जाता है:
questions.solution_en: Geology is the study of the Earth's structure, how it has changed over time, and its valuable resources like minerals and energy. It involves learning about everything related to the Earth.
questions.solution_hi: भूविज्ञान (Geology) पृथ्वी की संरचना, समय के साथ इसमें आए परिवर्तनों तथा खनिज व ऊर्जा जैसे इसके मूल्यवान संसाधनों के अध्ययन को कहते हैं। इसमें पृथ्वी से संबंधित हर चीज के बारे में सीखना शामिल है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following is an example of a major industrial region of India?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत के एक प्रमुख औद्योगिक क्षेत्र का उदाहरण है?
questions.solution_en:
The Chota Nagpur Plateau region is one of the most important industrial regions of India, mainly due to its rich mineral resources, particularly coal and iron ore. This region includes parts of Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and West Bengal, making it a hub for industries like steel, iron, and power generation.

· Bhojpur-Munger: Located in Bihar, not a major industrial region.

· Jaipur-Ajmer: Known more for tourism and small-scale industries.

· Bilaspur-Korba: Important for coal and thermal power but not as prominent as Chota Nagpur.

The Chota Nagpur region supports heavy industries like Bokaro Steel Plant, Tata Steel (Jamshedpur), and Durgapur Steel Plant.
questions.solution_hi:
छोटा नागपुर पठार क्षेत्र भारत के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण औद्योगिक क्षेत्रों में से एक है, मुख्यतः इसके समृद्ध खनिज संसाधनों, विशेषकर कोयला व लौह अयस्क के कारण। इस क्षेत्र में झारखंड, ओडिशा, छत्तीसगढ़ व पश्चिम बंगाल के हिस्से शामिल हैं।

• भोजपुर-मुंगेर: स्थित...

questions.q_en: Any natural mass of mineral matter that makes up the earth's crust is _____.
questions.q_hi: पृथ्वी की पर्पटी बनाने वाला खनिज पदार्थ का कोई भी प्राकृतिक द्रव्यमान _____ है।
questions.solution_en: A rock refers to any natural accumulation of mineral matter that comprises a part of the Earth's crust.
questions.solution_hi: चट्टान खनिज पदार्थ के किसी भी प्राकृतिक संचय को संदर्भित करती है जो पृथ्वी की पर्पटी का हिस्सा बनाती है।

questions.q_en: Which coal is low-grade, brown, and soft with high moisture content?
questions.q_hi: कौन सा कोयला निम्न-श्रेणी, भूरा व मुलायम होता है जिसमें उच्च नमी सामग्री होती है?
questions.solution_en: Lignite is a low-grade coal with high moisture content, making it less efficient for energy generation. It is softer and brownish in color compared to bituminous and anthracite.
questions.solution_hi: लिग्नाइट एक निम्न-श्रेणी का कोयला है जिसमें उच्च नमी सामग्री होती है, जिससे यह ऊर्जा उत्पादन हेतु कम कुशल होता है। यह बिटुमिनस व एन्थ्रेसाइट की तुलना में अधिक मुलायम व भूरे रंग का होता है।

questions.q_en: Mica is which type of mineral?
questions.q_hi: अभ्रक (माइका) किस प्रकार का खनिज है?
questions.solution_en:
· Mica is a group of silicate minerals known for their sheet-like structure and excellent electrical insulating properties.

· It is classified as a non-metallic mineral because it does not contain metal elements in a form that can be extracted for industrial use, unlike metallic minerals.

· Mica is widely used in industries for insulation in electrical equipment, in cosmetics (for shimmer), and in paints and coatings.
questions.solution_hi:
• अभ्रक (माइका) सिलिकेट खनिजों का एक समूह है जो अपनी परत-सदृश संरचना व उत्कृष्ट विद्युत रोधक गुणों के लिए जाना जाता है।

• इसे अधात्विक खनिज के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है क्योंकि इसमें धातु तत्व ऐसे रूप में नहीं होते जिन्हें औद्योगिक उपयोग हेतु निकाला जा सके।

questions.q_en: The Mundra Thermal Power Plant is located in which district of Gujarat?
questions.q_hi: मुंद्रा तापीय बिजली संयंत्र गुजरात के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.solution_en:
· ​The Mundra Thermal Power Plant is located in the Kutch district of Gujarat.

· Situated near Mundra Port within the Mundra Power Special Economic Zone (MPSEZ), this coal-based thermal power station is operated by Adani Power and boasts an installed capacity of 4,620 MW. ​

· Other Gujarat plants:

o Gandhinagar: Dhuvaran Power Station.

o Jamnagar: Reliance Refinery Plant.

· Thermal power plants are vital for India's electricity supply, contributing around 60% of the nation's total power generation.

· They provide essential base load power, supporting industrial growth and infrastructure development.

Further information:

Some important thermal power plants in India:

· Vindhyachal Thermal Power Station

o Located in Madhya Pradesh's Singrauli district, the Vindhyachal Thermal Power Station stands as India's largest thermal plant, boasting a 4,760MW capacity.

o Owned and managed by NTPC, its construction began in 1982, featuring 12 units.

o The plant relies on coal from Nigahi mine and water from Singrauli Super Thermal Power Station

· Mundra Ultra Mega Power Plant

o Located in Gujarat's Kutch district, the 4,000MW Mundra Ultra Mega Power Plant (UMPP) is India's third-largest thermal power plant.

o Operated by Coastal Gujarat Power Limited (CGPL), a Tata Power subsidiary, it features five 800MW units.

o Construction began in 2009, with the first unit operational in 2012.

· Sasan Ultra Mega Power Plant

o Situated in Singrauli district, Madhya Pradesh, the Sasan Ultra Mega Power Plant boasts a capacity of 3,960MW.

o Owned by Reliance Power, it's among India's largest, coupled with an integrated coal mine.

o Fully commissioned in 2015, it features six 660MW units fueled by coal from Moher and Moher-Amlohri mines.

o Water is drawn from Govind Vallabh Pant Sagar reservoir.

· Tiroda Thermal Power Plant

o The Tiroda thermal power plant in Maharashtra, India, stands as a 3,300MW coal-based facility under Adani Power Maharashtra's ownership.

o Comprising five 660MW units, it commenced operations between August 2012 and October 2014.

o Employing cutting-edge supercritical technology, it sources water from the Wainganga River.

· Talcher Super Thermal Power Station

o Situated in Odisha's Angul district, the Talcher Super Thermal Power Station, or NTPC Talcher Kaniha, boasts a 3,000MW capacity and is owned and operated by NTPC.

o With six 500MW units, it commenced operations between February 1995 and February 2005.

· Rihand Thermal Power Station

o Located in Rihandnagar, Sonebhadra district, Uttar Pradesh, the Rihand Thermal Power Station, owned by NTPC, boasts a 3,000MW capacity.

o Its six units, each generating 500MW, were commissioned between March 1988 and October 2013.

o Coal is sourced from Madhya Pradesh's mines, while water is drawn from the Rihand Reservoir on the Son River.

· Sipat Thermal Power Plant

o The Sipat Super Thermal Power Plant, located in Sipat, Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, is the eighth-largest in India with a 2,980MW capacity.

o Owned by NTPC, it features six units, a mix of 660MW supercritical and 500MW units, operational between August 2008 and June 2012. Renamed Rajiv Gandhi Super Thermal Power Station in 2013, it sources coal from Dipika Mines and water from the Right Bank Canal.

· Chandrapur Super Thermal Power Station

o The Chandrapur Super Thermal Power Station, Maharashtra's largest, boasts a 2,920MW capacity in Chandrapur.

o Operated by the Maharashtra State Power Generation Company, it comprises five 500MW units and two 210MW units, commissioned between 1985 and 2016.

o Drawing water from Erai and Chargaon dams, it satisfies a quarter of Maharashtra's electricity demand, exemplifying its critical role in the state's power supply.

· NTPC Dadri

o NTPC Dadri, also known as National Capital Power Station (NCPS), owned and operated by NTPC, is situated in Gautam Budh Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, 48km from New Delhi.

o With a 2637MW capacity, it ranks as India's sixth-largest thermal plant.

o Featuring six coal-fired units and six gas-based units, commissioned between 1991 and 2010, it draws coal from Piparwar Mines, gas from GAIL Hazira-Bijapur-Jagdishpur Pipeline, and water from Upper Ganga Canal.
questions.solution_hi:
• मुंद्रा तापीय बिजली संयंत्र गुजरात के कच्छ जिले में स्थित है।

• मुंद्रा पोर्ट के पास मुंद्रा पावर विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र (MPSEZ) में स्थित, यह कोयला-आधारित तापीय बिजली स्टेशन अडानी पावर द्वारा संचालित है और इसकी स्थापित क्षमता 4,620 मेगावाट है।
